acceptance_rule: PDF files are accepted only when they contain diagrams, part numbers, bilingual Arabic/English labels, and no visible marketplace/store/platform watermark, logo, source URL, or commercial source mark. A Nissan-only watermark is acceptable when it belongs to an original Nissan source.

Y60.reason: Visible source watermark/logo or source URL detected during visual QA.

Y61.reason: Visible PARTSOUQ.COM watermark detected inside diagram image.

carpartsmanual_pre_y60_candidate.reason: Candidate source contains real Nissan Patrol 60 parts diagrams, but raw diagram image includes www.CarPartsManual.com mark inside the image.

local_jdmcat_y60_candidate.reason: Local JDMCAT/Nengun-derived Y60 images contain a large non-Nissan watermark behind the diagrams.

last_web_search.result: No public clean official EPC/parts-catalog source was found for all requested Patrol generations. Search results were marketplace pages, service manuals, forums, Scribd-like documents, or physical catalog listings requiring purchase/access and visual verification.

allowed: Nissan-only source mark or watermark from an original Nissan source
